statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) was ordered for further diagnostic evaluation
The service addresses documented symptoms and supports identification of arrhythmia responsible for syncope
Diagnosis codes I49.5, R42, and R55 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
